STEP 3. Using the oscilloscope, check the sensor output 
voltage at ECM connector C-62.
(1) Do not disconnect the ECM connector C-62.
(2) Disconnect the combination meter connector and auto-
cruise control-ECU connector.
(3) Connect the oscilloscope probe to terminal 80 of the ECM 
by backprobing.
(4) Start the engine.
(5) Check the waveform.
• The waveform should show a pattern similar to the 
illustration while the vehicle is being moved.
(6) Turn the ignition switch to the "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the waveform normal?
YES : Go to Step 4.
NO : Go to Step 6.
STEP 4. Check connector C-62 at ECM for damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 5.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection (P.00E-2). Then go to Step 17.
